0022600135.text: The 76ers (3-1, 1st in the Atlantic, 2nd in the East) visit the Pacers (2-2, 8th in the East) for their fifth game of the season, after a loss in their most recent outing. Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back, fracture) and Tacko Fall (quadriceps, strain), and Jabari Walker, Joel Embiid and VJ Edgecombe are listed as day-to-day. Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery) and T.J. McConnell (hamstring, strain), with Andrew Nembhard and Ivica Zubac also day-to-day. The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, but the 76ers won the 2025-26 season series 4-0, most recently a 105-94 win in Indianapolis on April 10, 2026.
